neighbours.label: the word 'flash' (noun or verb)
fire: The neon signs flash all night above the old casino.
A sudden flash lit the whole valley for a second.
Police officers flash their lights to warn other drivers.
She caught a brief flash of red in the bushes.
Memories flash through his mind whenever he hears that song.
The camera's flash startled the sleeping cat.
The warning lamps flash twice before the gates close.
He would flash a grin at anyone who looked his way.
